text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly trimmed Stock D while it was well above my average cost; next time I’ll base sales on its outlook and portfolio risk, not just the pleasure of realizing a gain.","I added to Stock A at a higher price after buying it earlier; before adding, I’ll check whether the position still fits my plan rather than react to recent price moves.","A few active trades and short-term account swings don’t tell me whether my decisions are sound, so I’ll review my whole portfolio and use consistent rules for buying, holding, and selling."]}
